title: Tactical perception view
description: What one side knows under fog of war at an AI-controlled activation. Built by tactical/core, passed to that side's controller as plain data: decide(view, rng) gets no query functions; path, line-of-sight and shot previews are precomputed in allowedActions (TAI-001). Spec: TAI-001, TAI-002, TAI-004, TAI-006, TAI-008, TAI-012, TAC-094, TAC-095.

doctrine.description: One doctrine per side, from the tactical map request sides[].doctrine (TAI-015)

activeUnit.description: Unit to act, or null when the side chooses whom to activate (answered by activate or pass, TAI-002)

rank.description: From the tactical map request; sets the squad leader (TAI-013, TAC-094)

morale.description: Battle morale (TAC-095) plus the Leadership bonus while the leader is alive (TAC-094); survival input (TAI-008)

weaponJammed.description: TAC-083: the active weapon is jammed (clearJam)

squadMorale.description: Average battle morale of the side's units on the map, without the Leadership bonus (TAC-095, TAI-004)

position.description: Current position while visibleNow, else last seen or heard

visibleGear.description: What the player would see: weaponType, helmetClass, armourClass (TAI-004)

tiles.description: Known tiles: terrain cost, impassable and obscuring flags (TAC-029, TAC-082), edge cover, level, doors with state open | closed | locked (TAC-084), windows, destroyed state

contents.description: Only once searched by the side (TAC-070)
Only once searched by the side (TAC-070)

allowedActions.description: Precomputed answers the player UI would show (TAI-001, TAI-004): legal command types for the active unit with AP costs, path previews and shot previews

reachable.description: move: tiles with path AP cost and AP left (TAC-037)

targets.description: shoot / throwGrenade: targets in line of sight with the shot preview (TAC-046)

concealed.description: TAC-046 / TAC-082: target concealed; hitChance is the best case (unshifted cone)

battleGoal.description: The active unit's goal: its own from the request, else its side's (TAI-009, TAI-018)

objectives.description: Tactical-map objectives of the battle known to the side (TAC-076)
